units.source_text: 至今，给老师房间送展报还是我的任务。

en.t: Even now, delivering the morning paper to my teacher's room was still my duty.

units.source_text: 3月还有点微寒的清晨，我像平时一样到大门口去取报纸。

en.t: On a slightly chilly March morning, I went as usual to the main gate to fetch the newspapers.

units.source_text: 我从怀里掏出祗园艺妓的照片，

en.t: I took the photograph of the Gion geisha from inside my coat,

units.source_text: 夹在其中一张报纸里，这时我心潮沸腾起来了。

en.t: and slipped it into one of the newspapers; at that moment my heart began to surge.
